The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the subquery in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart07.java`. It matches the filter the per-quarter report already uses.

Reps with no purchase orders are still listed with 0, and the sort order (highest count first, then name and id) is unchanged.

I ran the tests matching `*SalesRep*` and they passed. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case or check your Anna/Bob example.
